Notes / substitutions: Must be a Raspberry Pi 4B (4GB or 8GB). Other Pi models are not supported.
PiSugar 3 or 3 Plus. Live battery readout in adminTAK depends on this board.
Any quality LiPo that fits your case and matches the PiSugar connector and polarity.
Any A1/U3 card runs netTAK. For offline maps (mbtileserver) size up: ~64 GB holds one map region ~512 GB the full map set.
Any short right-angle USB-C cable that fits your internal routing.
RP-SMA male-to-female bulkhead pigtails to bring antennas to the case wall.
Frees clearance for radios and adapters inside the case.
Panel-mount USB-C that brings the charge port out to the case wall. The 23.4 mm barrel matches the 3D-printed case cutout; sold in a 2-pack (the build uses one).
The signature Basecamp part. Two USB ports at the case wall for field-swappable package add-ons. The 24 mm barrel matches the 3D-printed case cutout.
Short jumper to route the panel-mounted USB to the Pi.
Chosen for its thin profile so it packs neatly inside the case. Any equally slim short Cat6 works.
Weatherproof RJ45 bulkhead for out-of-band / bridge access at the case wall. The 20 mm barrel matches the 3D-printed case cutout.
12 mm momentary push button. Wired to the PiSugar for power / shutdown.
M3 heat-set inserts for installing the covers.
Larger inserts for the external 1/2 inch mounting interface (tripod / mast / pole).
2.5 mm plastic screws to mount the Pi to the PiSugar and the case.
3 mm stainless machine screws that thread into the heat-set inserts to close up the case.
Required for netTAK Mesh. Sold by xTAK; do not substitute. Skip if not meshing.
Fits the printed case and is known for a fast fix. Any u-blox-based GPS works electrically but this one is sized for the case.
Dupont jumpers to wire the GPS module to the Pi GPIO UART.
Adds dual-band client coverage. Any RTL8812-based USB Wi-Fi adapter works - the ALFA is just our known-good pick.
High-gain RP-SMA antenna for the USB adapter - the adapter uses one; sold in a 2-pack. Match connector to your adapter.
Bridges an amateur (VHF/UHF) radio for digiTAK. Sold direct at digirig.net.
Short shielded USB-C cable for the digirig - keeps RF off the data line.
Pulls ADS-B / AIS off the air for sdrTAK. Recommended part coming.
Long-range LoRa mesh for loraTAK. Recommended part coming.
Live camera feeds to ATAK over the mesh. Recommended part coming.
Silent presence/motion detection dropped onto the map. Recommended part coming.
